title: Operator Kiosk: contextual shortcut palette for on-call flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an "operator kiosk" micro-surface in the Console that surfaces contextual shortcuts for on-call engineers: quick runbook task launches, idempotent remediation snippets, permissioned admin actions, and contextual telemetry links. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-action during incidents by providing a single place to discover and execute safe, pre-approved operator primitives. Scope: 1) UI surface with contextual suggestions based on alert/source/tag; 2) backend API to resolve allowed shortcuts per user/route; 3) integration with runbooks-as-tasks engine to enqueue safe micro-actions; 4) audit and telemetry hooks for every action. Exclusions: full runbook editor (out of scope), production autosurgery automation (only permissioned quick fixes), RBAC overhaul (use existing RBAC APIs). Acceptance criteria: - Kiosk appears in Console alert view and cluster page with contextual list populated for the current user. - Selecting a shortcut opens a confirmation modal with preflight checks (permission, dry-run status, estimated impact) and a one-click execute path. - Actions enqueue a runbook-task with metadata and produce traceable audit log entry and event in ops-telemetry. - Telemetry includes action latency, success/failure, token counts, and associated trace id for SLO correlation. Rollout: behind feature flag 'operator_kiosk_v1', gradual ramp to 10% of teams, increase after feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Kiosk appears in console contextually (alert, route, tag) for users with permission
Confirmation modal shows permission, dry-run toggle, and estimated impact
Executed actions create runbook tasks visible in the runbook task queue
Action audit events contain user, model, route, and trace id and appear in the audit stream
Telemetry dashboard surfaces per-action latency, success rate, and cost estimates
implementation_steps: Design UI micro-surface and confirmation modal (collab with Design)
Add backend endpoint /api/v1/operator-kiosk/shortcuts that resolves allowed shortcuts
Extend runbook-task API to accept 'kiosk_initiated' metadata and dry-run flag
Wire audit logger to emit structured events for kiosk actions
Instrument telemetry metrics and build a console dashboard tile
Feature-flag rollout and QA with synthetic incidents
risks: Exposing harmful admin actions — mitigated by strict allowlist and preflight confirmation
RBAC bypass — mitigated by backend permission checks and audit logging
Alert/context misclassification leading to wrong suggestions — mitigated by conservative matching rules
Operator overreliance on shortcuts causing drift — mitigate with usage telemetry and expiry of shortcuts
